reviewContext.userProblem: Build Telescreen v1: a 'Sentry for confidential-information retention violations'. Collectors (Slack, Google Drive/Docs/Sheets, GitHub, custom crawlers and AI agents, custom Police) scan content on events and schedules, detect credentials and PII without ever persisting raw values, group findings into Sentry-like issues, drive DB-persisted incident-response workflows with escalation, evidence gates and Police re-verification, and expose search (Meilisearch over masked data only), audit, MCP and agent chat, and a SolidJS UI.
requiredOutcomes: Reporting Bureau FastAPI app: push ingestion, issues with Sentry-like grouping/status/first-last-seen, workflow definitions/runs, police register/claim/heartbeat/result, evidence upload with rejection on PII/credentials, audit search, chat; plus an MCP server entrypoint.
Detectors rule, ml, managed_llm, local_llm behind one batched Detector interface, switchable by configuration; rule detector covers credentials and PII including Japanese formats.

Durable workflow engine from YAML/JSON with DB-persisted state: branching, send-back, human tasks with SLA escalation (slack/email), evidence gate, police verification, timers; tested on an SQLite-compatible harness.
Built-in Slack, Google Drive/Docs/Sheets and GitHub collectors with event and schedule triggers behind adapter interfaces with fakes.
IndexGuard blocks raw sensitive values before Meilisearch indexing; outbound notifications pass a DLP gate; audit log is append-only, hash-chained and searchable.
Versioned police contract (OpenAPI + JSON Schema), pull and signed push modes behind a PoliceGateway; standalone Police SDK (no telescreen.* imports) and an importable n8n push-mode example.

Map-reduce sweeps: map step, concurrent shards under a global max_concurrency, crash-safe without duplicate shards, 429 backpressure, count-only reduce with removal reconciliation, 10,000-shard concurrency-cap test.
SolidJS UI under src/web builds, typechecks and passes tests with issues, workflows/runs, police, collectors, escalation, audit, assistant and settings pages.
examples/compose and examples/workflows (GitHub credential leak multi-team remediation with escalation and police re-verification); README documents setup, architecture and usage.

Every plan passes its scoped Verification; p01 and p28 pass full-repository checks; final serial step: `mise run ci` then `cd src/web && bun install && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build`.
nonGoals: OIDC SSO (v1 uses bearer API tokens; OIDC deferred per design-docs/user-qa/qa-ui-authentication.md).
Airflow, n8n or Kestra as the core workflow engine (self-built durable engine in PostgreSQL; Airflow and n8n are usable only as push-mode Police or ingest clients).
Storing copies of monitored source content, or any raw detected value.
Database ForeignKey constraints, JSONB columns and database enums in v1 (p02 plan decision).
Running real network services or docker in the default offline test suite.
Re-theming internal modules with 1984 names (only Telescreen, Reporting Bureau and Police are themed).
constraints: English only, no emojis; plan files under 400 lines; Python files under 1000 lines.

Strict typing enforced by tools/typelint.py (TL001-TL010), ruff ANN/PGH and ty 0.0.85; no Any/object/dict/Mapping/TypedDict, no **kwargs or ** unpacking, no # type: ignore or # ty: ignore; data types are dataclasses or StrEnums; PEP 695 `type` statements for aliases; never a recursive alias (JsonValue is a self-referencing dataclass in telescreen.core.json).

Never persist, log, index, notify or return raw sensitive values; only masked representations and keyed HMAC fingerprints; leak tests over DB rows, logs, search documents, notifications, outbound HTTP bodies, evidence files, API responses and tracebacks.
Default `uv run pytest` passes offline; integration tests are marked `integration` and skip unless TELESCREEN_TEST_DATABASE_URL / TELESCREEN_TEST_MEILI_URL are set.

Only p01-foundation edits pyproject.toml, uv.lock, mise.toml, .gitignore, README.md, src/web/package.json and src/web/bun.lock; other plans use `--frozen` / `--frozen-lockfile` and file Reconciliation requests.

Any [tool.typelint.per-file-ignores] entry must be a narrow boundary module with a justification, owned by p01 or serial reconciliation, and called out in review; the ASGI TL005 ignore for the SDK is NOT pre-approved.
Police SDK (src/telescreen_police_sdk) never imports telescreen.*; the Bureau never imports the SDK except in contract tests.

All plans of a wave share one working directory and branch: write only inside writePaths, no git mutation commands, per-file sha256 drift logging (impl-plans/conventions.md section 2), verification shells start with `set -o pipefail` and `export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1`.
No secrets committed; examples use placeholders and env:/file: secret refs only.

SQLAlchemy table dunders (__tablename__, __table_args__) are written unannotated; typelint TL003 exempts class-body dunders (commit 7022a54). Never ClassVar[...] or `__tablename__: str` on ORM models (ty 0.0.85 invalid-attribute-override / dataclass-field-order).
ruff excludes Markdown (pyproject.toml extend-exclude ["*.md"]); never run ruff on plan or design .md files.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Self-built durable workflow engine on PostgreSQL instead of Airflow/n8n/Kestra: human-in-the-loop steps, send-back, evidence gates, DB-visible progress and raw-data-free guarantees (design-docs/specs/notes.md, design-workflow-engine.md).

Self-built durable map-reduce (map_jobs/map_partitions/map_items) inside the same engine for whole-estate sweeps; Airflow rejected as core but usable as a push-mode Police or ingest client (design-map-reduce-sweeps.md, notes.md).

Layered packages: telescreen.core (L0) and telescreen.ports (frozen Protocols and DTOs) let wave-4 feature packages run in parallel without importing each other; only p28 wiring.py/api/app.py cross L3 packages.

Police loose coupling through a versioned HTTP+JSON contract served at /api/police/v1/openapi.json, with pull (claim/heartbeat/result) and signed push (HMAC-SHA256, timestamp + nonce, one-time callback token) transports behind PoliceGateway.

Managed LLM provider selectable between Claude (default, claude-sonnet-5-5) and Codex; evidence accepts text and images, images scanned by the vision-capable managed LLM and failing closed (design-docs/user-qa/qa-llm-data-egress.md, qa-evidence-file-types.md).
Issue grouping key = source + resource key + rule class, with auto-resolve when a later complete scan no longer contains the finding and regression on reappearance.
Engine task queue polled from PostgreSQL with SKIP LOCKED leases, idempotency keys and retries (polling rationale in notes.md).
intentionalTradeoffs: No ForeignKey constraints in v1 so per-plan fakes and SQLite tests are insert-order independent; services keep integrity.

SQLite offline harness ignores row locks; concurrency correctness of the 32-item dispatch bound is additionally covered by a PostgreSQL integration variant in p26, and concurrent sessions on the in-memory SQLite harness are banned.
DR-1: a sweep with resources_failed > 0 ends partial and skips removal reconciliation (resolve_unchecked) to avoid false auto-resolves.
DR-4: a Google Drive 404 caused by lost access is classified as removed (accepted design).

Shared-working-directory overwrites are mitigated by sha256 drift logging, serial reconciliation and p28's full-repository run rather than worktree isolation; a deleted test file would show only in drift logs.
p24 (workflow engine) is the largest plan and on the critical path; p28 depends on every wave-3/4 feature plan.
supportedEdgeCases: Full-width digits and NFKC-expanded characters in phone and My Number detection with spans mapped to original text.
Placeholder values (changeme, ${VAR}, <secret>) and Luhn/My Number check-digit failures produce no findings.
Composite cascade stage failure keeps rule findings and marks results degraded.
Duplicate advance_step delivery causes no double transition; replayed push nonces are rejected; one-time result tokens cannot be reused.
429 rate limiting pauses map dispatch until Retry-After; late police results for timed-out items are ignored; shard timeout retries then fails with sweep_timeout.
GitHub forced push or compare 404 falls back to a full listing; renames yield removed plus changed.
Evidence: mismatched magic bytes or unknown types -> 415; truncated image -> rejected malformed_image; scanner unavailable -> fail closed.
Workflow sources containing a raw sample are rejected with raw_value_detected; step outputs with samples are stored redacted.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Real external API or docker execution in default tests.
Installing the optional ml extra (transformers/torch) in CI; MlDetector is tested with a fake classifier and degrades gracefully when unavailable.
map steps over inline `items:` or `via: sub_workflow` (rejected as unsupported_field in v1).
